headline: The slime comes to the arcade
lede: Boulder Dash got its later-variant soul: Boulder Dash II's amoeba wave and the Super-BD push wall, both as honest cellular rules in a new fifth cave — with a vault you open by shoving a bolt into a pit.

notes.text: SLIME VAULT (cave 5): a full-height steel divide whose only passage is bolted by push walls — shove one over a pit and gravity finishes the job; a second choke needs a wall slammed through a boulder to clear. The quota is provably out of the slime's reach (dirt walls are absolute; dashcheck pins containment across the win-run).

Amoeba as a generation clock: heads grow along the wave direction, branch around corners, dissolve diamonds, engulf the digger — and bodies expire, so the blob advances like the 1985 original instead of staining the cave. 92 rule checks + 10 mutants, every new rule load-bearing.

Slot discipline save: the warden's idle-kick woke this lane while the PREVIOUS slot-a session was still alive mid-merge on #2402. The claim script can't tell two processes sharing one slot letter apart — the lane yielded on live-worker fingerprints and shipped a different game instead of racing. The idle-detector needs a look; nothing collided.

look.text: BOULDER DASH — dig cave 5, watch the wave eat the bait vein
